publicly_funded.reason: Paid mainly by private advertisers and cable/satellite distributors for Radio One stations, TV One and iOne Digital; not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its radio, TV One cable and digital media operations; acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers can easily shift ad spend to other media; audiences and distributors can easily change content sources.
